name: cleanroom_r2e_reaction_center_feature_v1
purpose: Target the persistent reaction-similarity <0.3 R2E failure with a deterministic atom-mapped mechanism-local representation rather than further DRFP replay or loss retuning.
development_benchmarks: clean2023 strict protein+reaction entity-disjoint historical folds 0/1/2 only

extension.changed_center_definition: endpoints of mapped bonds whose presence/order changes, plus common mapped atoms whose atomic-number/formal-charge/total-H/aromatic/chiral state changes

candidate.mapping_role: chemical atom-correspondence preprocessing only; no enzyme-reaction association score or target label is used
candidate.mapping_feasibility_audit_before_perform: RXNMapper success covers 204/204 preregistered <0.3 development queries across folds0/1/2; this is input-availability evidence, not label-performance selection.
candidate.training_recipe: exact frozen RDKit+ cleanroom recipe: 8 epochs x 60 steps, hard80/random8, hidden768/embed320, lr3e-4, weight_decay1e-4, temp0.035, topk10/weight1.0, margin0.12, r2e_weight0.98, seed20260723; novelty replay disabled

screening_rule.fold_stability: Hard-slice MRR and MAP must both improve in at least 2 of 3 development folds; neither may regress by more than 0.005 absolute in any fold.
screening_rule.broad_all_query_guard: Across pooled folds0/1/2 R2E, MRR/MAP may not regress by >0.002 absolute and Hit@10/20/50 may not regress by >0.005 absolute.
screening_rule.if_pass: Freeze a new deterministic salted strict double-cold confirmation protocol before materializing confirmation performance. Historical fold3, old salted fold6, Enzyme-405, temporal and ReactZyme outer cells cannot serve as unbiased confirmation.
screening_rule.if_fail: Reject center-v1 without tuning radius, dimensions, token hash or training recipe from these results; any successor is a new preregistered mechanism.
